outline.chapter_title: Chapter 1 – Factual Background and the Charged Offense
outline.description: Sets out the underlying events, the conduct alleged, and the statutory elements of the felon‑in‑possession charge and the Armed Career Criminal Act (ACCA) enhancements.
subtopics: Chronology of the November 19‑20, 2020 incident
Defendant’s criminal history and relevance to ACCA
Statutory framework: 18 U.S.C. §§ 922(g)(1) and 924(e)
Physical evidence: sawed‑off Marlin .22, DNA match, knife, and cell phone
Victim and witness testimony (D.F. and C.F.)

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 2 – Procedural Posture and the Appeal Landscape
outline.description: Explains how the case moved from the district court trial to the appellate review, identifying the issues raised by Cutbank and the standard of review applied by the Eighth Circuit.
subtopics: Trial court proceedings: jury verdict and sentencing under the Guidelines
Defendant’s post‑conviction motions and the appellate brief
Scope of appellate review: abuse‑of‑discretion standard for evidentiary rulings, de novo review of sentencing calculations
Preservation of error doctrine and harmless‑error analysis

outline.description: Analyzes each of the defendant’s evidentiary objections, the district court’s rulings, and the appellate court’s reasoning for affirming those rulings.
subtopics: Rule 404(b) propensity issue – prior possession testimony as intrinsic evidence
Confrontation‑Clause and hearsay concerns – D.F.’s statements to police and jury instructions
Admission of prior‑inconsistent statements and the relevance of D.F.’s sister’s death
Authentication requirements for extrinsic impeachment evidence (C.F.’s police report)
Harmless‑error doctrine – evaluation of cumulative prejudice and relevant case law

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 4 – Sentencing Calculations and the § 2K2.1(b)(6)(B) Enhancement
outline.description: Details the sentencing guidelines computation, the contested enhancement, and the appellate court’s application of the relevant statutory and guideline authority.
subtopics: Guidelines base offense level for sawed‑off firearms (USSG § 2K2.1(b)(6))
Breakdown of the four‑level enhancements applied by the PSR
Legal standard for applying § 2K2.1(b)(6)(B) – firearm possession in connection with another felony
Review of the district court’s acceptance of the PSR’s factual findings
§ 3553(a) factors, discretionary range, and the harmless‑error/ reasonableness review

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 5 – Holding, Reasoning, and Broader Significance
outline.description: Summarizes the appellate court’s final judgment, the key legal principles affirmed, and the case’s instructional value for future felon‑in‑possession and ACCA sentencing disputes.
subtopics: Affirmation of conviction and sentence
Reiteration of abuse‑of‑discretion and harmless‑error standards
Clarification of when prior possession evidence is admissible under Rule 404(b)
Guidance on proper authentication of extrinsic impeachment material
Impact on the application of § 2K2.1(b)(6)(B) and the interaction with § 3553(a) sentencing goals
